idea: Two shaped ribbons weave towards a centre. Tactile terracotta gives matching a more personal feel.

idea: Two sculpted pebbles hold a shared opening. Earthy, organic and intentionally less clinical.

idea: Two angular pieces snap into an open centre. Cobalt and lime give matching a sharper, more energetic personality.

idea: Two offset corners turn around a bright centre. A graphic, confident alternative to rounded healthcare shapes.

idea: Two cut shapes form a spark in the centre. Bold violet and bright mint keep the matching idea abstract.

idea: An ampersand carries the idea of patient and clinic together. Wine and warm brass feel more editorial.

idea: A refined D and M sit on either side of a brass meeting point. A more formal identity for major-care decisions.

idea: A bright inner shape sits inside a soft outer frame. Sunflower and amber make the identity feel open and optimistic.

name: The friendly pivot
idea: Three rounded pieces turn around a shared opening. Coral and apricot give the mark warmth and movement.

name: A good duo
idea: Two soft comma shapes turn towards each other. Aubergine and warm peach make a cheerful, human matching symbol.
